theme_and_identity.tagline: SaaS, IoT, Web App, Mobile App
theme_and_identity.vibe: Professional, Industrial Tech, Sleek, Data-Heavy, Elegant

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for H1/H2.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, inputs, and general text.

mono.usage: Use for data values, test results, and AI analysis confidence scores.

rules: Labels must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), and wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Pure black (#000000) is banned. Use zinc-950 as the deepest dark.
Use true gray surfaces (zinc) to reduce eye fatigue.
Accent color (amber) should be used sparingly for primary actions (Export PDF, Analyze).
Never use full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with subtle borders.

sidebar.content: Logo/Brand name at top, navigation links below.

bento_grid.usage: Use for the landing page statistics or feature highlights.

layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) inside cards.
rules: Cards should have 1px solid border (border-zinc-800) and no shadow in dark mode (or very subtle ambient shadow).

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md), high contrast.

cards.style: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default.

tables.style: Dense, clean borders. Striped or simple divider lines.
tables.header: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-800

inputs.style: Dark background, subtle border, colored focus ring.
inputs.classes: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 focus:border-amber-500/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500/50 text-sm

badges.style: Subtle tint background with high contrast text.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have hover states (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transitions (transition-colors duration-200), NEVER transition-all.
motion_and_interactions.active_states: Navigation links should highlight the active route clearly with a subtle background and amber left-border indicator.

images.usage: Hero background or accent image for the SaaS/IoT landing page section, with heavy dark overlay (bg-zinc-950/80).
Use as a card thumbnail or subtle background for the laboratory testing modules.

landing_page.layout: Hero section with large Outfit heading 'Elastech Production'. Subheading for 'SaaS, IoT, Web App, Mobile App'. Followed by a bento grid showing quick stats or introducing the 3 lab testing modules.
landing_page.vibe: High visual impact, elegant dark mode portfolio.

testing_modules.shared_layout: Header with Module Title and 'Export to PDF' button. Main content split into two columns: Left for Data Input Form, Right for AI Analysis Result and Results Table.
sections: Data Input Form: Selects, text inputs for sample details.
Rating Assessment: Visual indicator or dropdown.
AI Analysis Card: A highlighted card (maybe subtle blue or amber glowing border) containing AI insights.
Results Table: Historical or current run data displayed cleanly.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Text on dark backgrounds must be legible.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, nav links) MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='nav-khtt-analyst', data-testid='export-pdf-btn').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Do NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Create depth using 1px borders and slight background color variations (zinc-950 vs zinc-900) instead of heavy shadows.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers or surfaces with content underneath.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily but customize them to fit the dark zinc theme.
Use standard HTML forms integrated with Shadcn for the lab testing inputs.
